Yes. Your itinerary, boarding passes, and travel documents in the wallet are available even with no signal - handy at the gate or abroad.

# We’re here to help

Questions, bugs, or feedback about Tripmojo - reach us any time.

## Common questions

### How do I add a booking?

Forward a confirmation email, snap a photo, or drop in a PDF - Tripmojo’s AI reads it and files the flight, hotel, train, or reservation onto the right day of your trip.

### How do I travel with friends?

Open a trip, tap share, and send the invite link. Everyone who joins gets the same live itinerary, suggestions, and shared expenses. You can also send a view-only follow link for family who just want to watch the trip unfold.

### How do I split expenses?

Add an expense inside a trip, choose who paid and how to split it, and Tripmojo shows who owes whom. Settle up in a tap - no separate bill-splitting app needed. [...] Company website:candlestudios.dev · Support: support@tripmojo.ai

results.title: Tripmojo walkthrough
results.content:
# Tripmojo walkthrough

Every group trip ends up with one unpaid travel agent fielding nonstop questions.
Other apps stop at planning - Tripmojo builds your shared trip and runs it for you. [...] Connect Gmail once (read-only) and Tripmojo turns your booking emails into one shared trip with flights, hotels, and plans. Drop one link in the chat so everyone sees the same trip. Inside the group chat, Mojo - your trip's AI agent - pulls spots from shared reels, compares options like Friday dinner, and keeps a group brief of what is agreed and what is still open. Twenty-four hours before takeoff, Mojo checks the whole group in, syncs offline boarding passes, and handles trip chores like seats, meals, visa rules, eSIMs, gate changes, and late checkout. Free on iOS, Android, and web, with no paywall and no trial.
